task.description: RE-GATE of REQ-373's design after rework iteration 1. Your prior handoff (step-01b-design-gate.json) FAILed the design on exactly one dimension: the new `status` field's casing was internally self-contradictory (uppercase DB migration vs lowercase behavior-prose atoms, no Ecto.Enum declaration). CODE-DESIGNER's rework (commit 6cbcaa5f) claims to have reconciled this by declaring `status` as a plain `Ecto.Enum, values: [:ACTIVE, :RETIRED]` (uppercase Elixir-side atoms matching required_auth's own convention) and updating every status literal across the doc to match. Re-read lib/letflow/design/req373-service-catalog-version-lifecycle.md INDEPENDENTLY and in full -- do not trust the rework's own self-report. Specifically: (a) confirm the Ecto.Enum declaration and values: mapping is now stated explicitly and unambiguously; (b) grep/scan the ENTIRE document yourself for any remaining lowercase :active/:retired literal that was missed by the rework -- do not assume the rework note's claimed section list (§3.1-3.3, §5) was exhaustive, check the whole file; (c) confirm no other content was altered beyond what the casing reconciliation required (the prior PASS checks -- schema-decision reasoning, AC4 retire-vs-fallback resolution, PinResolver.Lookup contract usage, :AdminServicesManage permission reuse -- should remain byte-equivalent in substance; spot check at least two of them still hold). Do NOT re-run the full first-pass gate from scratch if it wastes effort duplicating already-confirmed-sound sections, but DO independently verify rather than trust that nothing regressed. FAIL if any lowercase status atom remains anywhere in the document, or if the Ecto.Enum declaration is still missing/ambiguous, or if any unrelated content was altered. Otherwise PASS. Set this handoff's status to COMPLETED with your genuine verdict, commit and push before ending your turn.
acceptance_criteria: service_catalog entries carry a version identity and an ACTIVE/RETIRED status, with the chosen schema stated explicitly in the moduledoc along with the reasoning, proven by a migration and a schema test
status field's Ecto representation (Ecto.Enum declaration + values: mapping) is stated explicitly and used consistently (no casing contradiction) throughout the entire document

No unrelated content drift detected.
